fixes.name: credential fix
fixes.body:
1. Run `gh auth login`
2. Verify SSH key: `ssh -T git@github.com`
3. Check token expiration in GitHub Settings

fixes.name: mirror fix
fixes.body:
Configure pip mirror:
```bash
pip config set global.index-url https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple
```

fixes.name: install fix
fixes.body:
Install the missing package:
```bash
pip install pandas
```

fixes.name: config fix
fixes.body:
Set the environment variable:
```bash
export APP_CONFIG=/etc/app/config.yaml
```

fixes.name: restart fix
fixes.body:
Restart the service:
```bash
sudo systemctl restart myapp
```

fixes.name: upgrade fix
fixes.body:
Upgrade the package:
```bash
pip install --upgrade requests
```

fixes.name: clean fix
fixes.body:
Clear the cache:
```bash
rm -rf ~/.cache/pip
pip install requests
```
